stories.title: After CIA And FBI, Hackers Now Breach US Air Force's Key Cloud Platform; Sensitive Military Data At Risk
stories.summary: Hackers have breached the US Air Force's Cloud One platform, a crucial cloud service used for military applications. This incident is part of a growing trend of cyberattacks targeting US government agencies, putting sensitive military data at risk.

stories.title: Florida man used AI to clone a popular streamer's voice and trick crypto investors into $260,000 scam, US
stories.summary: A man in Florida reportedly used artificial intelligence to imitate a popular streamer's voice. He then used this cloned voice to deceive cryptocurrency investors, leading to a scam totaling $260,000.

stories.title: After FIFA And CIA, Hackers Target Europe's Biggest Tech Company SAP In Cyberattack
stories.summary: SAP, a major European tech company, has confirmed a security incident known as Project Granite. Reports suggest that hackers may have gained access to the company's source code by using stolen employee tokens and AI agents.

stories.title: Govt Warns WhatsApp Users: How Your Personal Data Could Be At Risk And Here's What To Do
stories.summary: CERT-In has issued a high-severity warning to users of WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business on various platforms, including Android, iOS, Windows, and Mac. The warning indicates potential security flaws that could put personal data at risk.

stories.title: Boat Airdopes Prime 701 ANC Review: Big Features at a Budget Price
stories.summary: The Boat Airdopes Prime 701 ANC are reviewed as offering significant features at an affordable price. These earbuds include 46dB hybrid active noise cancellation, spatial audio, AI-powered calling, and up to 40 hours of battery life, making them a good choice for daily use under Rs 2,000.

stories.title: Setback for Tata Trusts: Tata Sons board meeting to be held as scheduled, says HC
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court has ruled that the Tata Sons board meeting will proceed as scheduled on November 30, denying interim relief to Tata Trusts. Tata Trusts is challenging the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as chairperson, arguing that approval from their nominee directors is necessary. This decision highlights an ongoing power struggle within Tata Sons.

stories.title: Stocks Set to Rally at End of a Week of Wild Swings
stories.summary: After a week of significant market fluctuations, stocks are expected to rally. This follows a holiday-shortened trading period that saw considerable volatility for investors.

stories.title: Stock market today: Sensex falls over 600 points, Nifty slips below 25,750 after 2-day rally
stories.summary: The Sensex dropped over 600 points and the Nifty fell below 25,750 today, following a two-day rally in the stock market.

stories.title: SAP Layoffs: Company Weighs Cutting At Least 10,000 Jobs In AI Restructuring
stories.summary: SAP is considering a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 jobs as part of a restructuring driven by artificial intelligence. This indicates a potential major change in the software company's workforce.

stories.title: RBI lowers minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 99% to 90%
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has reduced the minimum daily Cash Reserve Ratio maintenance requirement from 99% to 90%.

stories.title: Delimitation Showdown: Modi Cabinet's 50% Seat Plan, DMK's Conditions & Cong Huddle |Breaking Ground
stories.summary: The Modi Cabinet is considering a plan for seat allocation, which has led to discussions within the DMK and Congress parties. This development highlights ongoing political negotiations regarding representation.

stories.title: SC's Landmark Deepam Order: Light Deepathoon Tomorrow; Temple Board Suspended, CRPF In-Charge Of Security
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has issued a significant order regarding the Deepam event, instructing that it proceed tomorrow. As a result, the temple board has been suspended, and the CRPF will now be responsible for security.

stories.title: Spain to vote for a new Prime Minister in Sunday snap election
stories.summary: Spain will hold a snap election on Sunday to choose its next Prime Minister.

stories.title: Supreme Court to tackle AR-15 bans in blockbuster Second Amendment case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court is set to hear a major case concerning bans on AR-15 style rifles, which will address Second Amendment rights.

stories.title: US may ban China-made cars as lawmakers reach deal with auto industry: What it could mean for Tesla, Ford
stories.summary: The United States is considering a potential ban on cars manufactured in China, following an agreement between lawmakers and the auto industry. This move could have implications for various car manufacturers.

stories.title: IBM to cease US visa, green card sponsorship for most consulting roles
stories.summary: IBM will no longer sponsor US work visas or green cards for most of its consulting positions. This change means that individuals in these roles will need to secure their own immigration status to work for the company in the US.

stories.title: Infosys sees eightfold rise in US H-1B approvals as Texas prepares to change visa policy: Report
stories.summary: Infosys has reportedly seen a significant increase in its H-1B visa approvals in the US. This rise comes as the state of Texas is preparing to implement changes to its visa policies.

stories.title: Columbia-affiliated Barnard College resumes CPT approvals for international students | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Barnard College, which is affiliated with Columbia University, has restarted its approvals for Curricular Practical Training (CPT) for international students. This allows international students to gain work experience related to their studies.

stories.title: Thousands of international students in Connecticut could face new work hurdles under Trump proposal
stories.summary: A new proposal could create difficulties for thousands of international students in Connecticut seeking work opportunities. If implemented, this change could impact their ability to work while studying in the US.

stories.title: US Labor Department Proposes Stricter Green Card Rules
stories.summary: The US Labor Department has put forward a proposal to make the rules for obtaining green cards more stringent. This could affect the process for individuals seeking permanent residency in the United States.
